units.source_text: 礼毕，众人退出，赴侍所[\[30\]](#part1330.html#m30)，大开琼筵。

en.t: When the ceremony was over, everyone withdrew and went to the samurai offices, where a splendid banquet was held.

units.source_text: 源氏公子在诸亲王末座就席。

en.t: Prince Genji took his seat at the lowest place among the imperial princes.

units.source_text: 左大臣在席上隐约提及葵姬之事。

en.t: During the banquet, the Minister of the Left hinted indirectly at the matter of Lady Aoi.

units.source_text: 公子年事尚幼，腼腆含羞，默默不答。

en.t: The young prince was still very young, and out of shy embarrassment he remained silent and gave no answer.

units.source_text: 不久内侍宣旨，召左大臣参见。

en.t: Before long, a court lady conveyed an imperial command summoning the Minister of the Left to an audience.
The Minister of the Left entered the inner palace and appeared before the emperor.

units.source_text: 御前诸命妇便将加冠犒赏品赐与左大臣：照例是白色大褂一件、衣衫一套。

en.t: The ladies in attendance before the emperor then bestowed the rewards for the coming-of-age ceremony upon the Minister of the Left: as customary, one white outer robe and a complete set of garments.
They also presented him with a cup of wine.
